summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests a DNA vaccine called pNGVL4aCRTE6E7L2 in women with HPV16-positive high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2 or CIN3). The vaccine is given as an intramuscular injection with TriGrid electroporation at escalating doses of 0.3 mg, 1.0 mg, and 3.0 mg, and how often doses are given is not stated. The main goal is to measure safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna de ADN llamada pNGVL4aCRTE6E7L2 en mujeres con neoplasia cervical intraepitelial de alto grado (CIN2 o CIN3) positiva para VPH16. La vacuna se aplica como inyección intramuscular con electroporación TriGrid, en dosis crecientes de 0,3 mg, 1,0 mg y 3,0 mg, y no se indica con qué frecuencia se aplican las dosis. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Adult women aged 19 or older with biopsy-confirmed CIN2 or CIN3 on colposcopy.
Cervical sample positive for HPV16 on an FDA-approved genotyping test.
HIV-negative, or HIV-positive with documented HIV-1 infection and willingness to take effective antiretroviral therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy greater than 4 months.
Normal blood counts and organ function within 45 days of enrollment.
not_for: Active or chronic hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
Metal implants at the injection site or electronic stimulation devices such as pacemakers.
Active autoimmune disease such as lupus, celiac disease, or multiple sclerosis.
